title: Cryptocurrencies and Decentralized Finance
evidence_summary: The IMF identifies 9 May 2022 as the TerraUSD collapse date, describes the failed UST peg mechanism and the linked collapse of LUNA and the Terra system.

title: SEC Charges Terraform and CEO Do Kwon with Defrauding Investors in Crypto Schemes
evidence_summary: The SEC identifies UST as Terraform's algorithmic stablecoin, LUNA as its linked token, and states that UST depegged in May 2022 while UST and sister-token prices fell close to zero.

title: Celsius Founder and Former Chief Revenue Officer Charged in Connection with Multibillion-Dollar Fraud
evidence_summary: The DOJ states Celsius halted customer withdrawals on 12 June 2022, filed for Chapter 11 on 13 July 2022, and identifies CEL as Celsius's proprietary token.

title: FTC Reaches Settlement with Crypto Platform Celsius Network
evidence_summary: The FTC describes Celsius as bankrupt, states customers lost access to assets, and records allegations that the platform and executives misrepresented liquidity and safety.

title: Voyager Digital Provides Market Update
evidence_summary: Voyager announced suspension of trading, deposits, withdrawals and loyalty rewards effective 14:00 EDT on 1 July 2022 after a counterparty default.

title: FTC Reaches Settlement with Crypto Company Voyager Digital
evidence_summary: The FTC identifies Voyager as bankrupt, records that customers lost access to assets, and states Voyager declared bankruptcy in July 2022.

title: CFTC Charges Sam Bankman-Fried, FTX Trading and Alameda with Fraud and Material Misrepresentations
evidence_summary: The CFTC alleges fraud and misappropriation through 11 November 2022 and records losses exceeding eight billion dollars in customer deposits.

title: SEC Charges Caroline Ellison and Gary Wang with Defrauding Investors in Crypto Asset Trading Platform FTX
evidence_summary: The SEC identifies FTT as an FTX-issued token, alleges its price was manipulated to support collateral values, and describes the collapse of FTT and FTX in November 2022.

title: Primary and Secondary Markets for Stablecoins
evidence_summary: The Federal Reserve states that on 10 March 2023 Circle reported reserves at Silicon Valley Bank and USDC then depegged significantly in secondary markets.

title: $3.3 Billion of USDC Reserve Risk Removed, Dollar De-peg Closes
evidence_summary: Circle states that the reserve exposure would become fully available and explicitly describes the dollar depeg as closed.
